summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code or tests, and without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/_tabs.py with the Tabs widget and TabActivated message (click activates nearest tab; left/right wrap; number keys activate by 1-based index; letter keys cycle through matching labels; no tabs renders only the inactive underline; docstrings included). Exported Tabs and TabActivated from src/textual/widgets/__init__.py. Added sandbox/tabs.py demo (python -m tabs from sandbox dir) and an Unreleased entry in CHANGELOG.md. Syntax was checked with ast.parse only. Not verified: rendering positions, event bubbling of TabActivated to the app, and the demo at runtime. No tests were added. Suggested tests to add: tab_spans, tab_at, find_letter.
